notes_for_editor: Two sources (firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page) agree on the 1934 build and the 1955 destruction, and the Forest Lookouts page cites Kresek for the build details. The 1936 item says the two women went up to visit Irene's father, W. L. Mohl, so his presence at the lookout is implied rather than stated. The Sanders County claim is supported by the firelookout.com location line. The L-4 description comes from the Sanders County Ledger and is a general description of the cab type, not a measured description of this cab. No source describes the site today, and no access level is recorded.
